ui.title: GRAVSHIFT
ui.menu_hint: Up and down to choose, Space or Enter to confirm
ui.upgrade_hint: Left and right then Space, keys 1 2 3 or click

gameplay.tagline: Your ship is a gravity well.
gameplay.controls: Move: arrows or WASD     Well: Space or left click, held     Nova: E or right click     Pause: Esc
gameplay.boss_guardian_sub: Its shields stop your shots: aim for the gaps
gameplay.boss_singularity_sub: It pulls you in: circle it, send its fire back

help.capture: Hold Space: the well pulls in the orange bullets and puts them in orbit. It burns flux.
help.sling: Release: every orbiting bullet flies back at an enemy and hits three times harder than your shot.
help.crash: The well pulls enemies too. Thrown into each other, they break.
help.nova: Collect the blue shards, graze bullets. With a full gauge, E swallows the whole screen and sends it back.
help.heavy: Spiked red orbs escape gravity: dodge them, or graze them to charge the Nova.

feedback.twist_tip: Bullet captured: release to send it back

upgrades.desc_horizon: The well pulls and captures 20% further.
upgrades.desc_sling: Bullets sent back deal 40% more damage.
upgrades.desc_twin: One more automatic shot, +15% fire rate.
upgrades.desc_shrapnel: Bullets sent back burst on impact and hit the neighbours.
upgrades.desc_pierce: Bullets sent back go through one more enemy.
upgrades.desc_grinder: Orbiting bullets no longer wear out when they hit.
upgrades.desc_recoil: The release wave reaches 60% further and stuns.
upgrades.desc_magnet: Shards come from twice as far and charge the Nova 50% faster.
upgrades.desc_supernova: The Nova lasts 40% longer and its slings deal 50% more damage.
